Answer: C
Reason: Comparison of the two images reveals that the extensive consolidation initially present in the left lung (Figure 1) has largely resolved, while new patchy opacities have appeared in the right upper lung zone (Figure 2). This pattern of clearing original infiltrates accompanied by new contralateral consolidations is characteristic of migratory infiltrates seen in Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP), consistent with option C.
